specs.label: File menu hook mounts the Files dialogs overlay
specs.note: installFileMenuHooks (FileDropTarget) registers file_open; File ▸ Open… -> requestFilesAction -> openPanel('files') mounts FilesPanel, whose "File ▾" strip and (in local mode, no bridge) the "file service unavailable" indicator appear.

specs.label: File ▾ button opens the strip dropdown
specs.note: Clicking the panel's own "File ▾" button toggles menuOpen and re-runs ensure(); the dropdown of file actions appears.

specs.label: Escape closes the strip dropdown
specs.note: FilesPanel installs a window keydown listener while menuOpen; Escape sets menuOpen=false (QMenu parity).

specs.label: Second File ▾ click closes the dropdown
specs.note: setMenuOpen((v)=>!v): a second press collapses the open dropdown.

specs.label: Click outside closes the strip dropdown
specs.note: A mousedown outside .files__strip closes the dropdown (QMenu click-away parity). Click the menu-bar as the outside target.

specs.label: File-service-unavailable indicator (local backend)
specs.note: ensure() bootstraps cmd.tenmol_files via a Python {t:do}; the in-browser TS engine has no such symbol, so ensure rejects and the red ".files__error" indicator reads "file service unavailable". This is the expected local-mode surface and proves the bootstrap error path is wired.

specs.label: Ctrl+S window accelerator (session save)
specs.note: FileDropTarget window keydown: Ctrl/Cmd+S runs ensure()+session_file+save; in local mode ensure() rejects and it reports a save failure to the feedback log — proving the accelerator is installed. (windowAccelerator ignores Ctrl+Alt+S.)

checks.pattern: save failed|session has no file|no file yet

specs.label: Ctrl+O window accelerator (open file picker)
specs.note: FileDropTarget window keydown: Ctrl/Cmd+O creates a hidden <input type=file> and clicks it, opening the BROWSER file dialog (native, outside the DOM) then upload+load. The native chooser cannot be driven or observed deterministically by Playwright, and the load path needs the bridge — recorded here for inventory; drive/verify manually.

specs.label: Window drag-and-drop file load
specs.note: FileDropTarget listens for window dragover/drop: a URL drop -> cmd.load; a File drop -> upload then load, with refusals (.pwg) and dialog-required formats reported. Synthesising a real DataTransfer drop with files is not deterministic via the audit driver, and the upload/classify path needs the bridge. Drive/verify manually.

specs.label: Deep link ?open=<path> loads a file on start
specs.note: takeOpenFromLocation consumes ?open=<path> once on mount (StrictMode-safe, strips the param) and runs requestFilesOpen -> plan_open. Needs the bridge to classify/load the path; a bare local start has no ?open. Recorded for inventory.

specs.label: Plugin file-dialog host (tkinter mimic)
specs.note: PluginDialogHost (always mounted by FileDropTarget) subscribes to the "dialog" topic; when a legacy plugin blocks in tkinter.filedialog the bridge pushes a request and this opens the same PathPicker, answering via _bridge.answer_dialog. No bridge -> no dialog events; BLOCKED.
